name: Ahsan Manzil (Pink Palace)

confidenceLegend.[V]: Verified in published heritage/tourism sources listed below.
confidenceLegend.[C]: Conflicting sources; resolve with footprint trace or imagery.
confidenceLegend.[E]: Estimate/placeholder; retain as an editable parameter.
confidenceLegend.[?]: Unknown; default exists only to keep the model buildable.

sources.note: Coordinates near 23.7085972 N, 90.4060583 E agree closely with supplied anchor. Anchor still remains [C] until footprint polygon centroid is traced.

sources.title: A Palace on the River: Ahsan Manzil — The Daily Star, Adnan Zillur Morshed

latitude.source: User-supplied anchor; Wikipedia coordinates (23.7085972 N, 90.4060583 E) agree closely; alternate listings reported in the brief conflict
latitude.note: Retain [C] until the outline is traced and the origin is moved to the actual footprint centroid.

longitude.source: User-supplied anchor; Wikipedia coordinates (23.7085972 N, 90.4060583 E) agree closely; alternate listings reported in the brief conflict
longitude.note: Retain [C] until the outline is traced and the origin is moved to the actual footprint centroid.

longAxisAzimuthDegrees.source: Approximate east-west direction in supplied brief

axes.value: X east-west; Y up; +Z south / river-front

riverFacade.source: Bangladesh Tourism Board and supplied brief

rangmahalBlockLength.source: 183 ft (55.8 m) whole front facade width reported in the architectural article by Adnan Zillur Morshed / The Daily Star
rangmahalBlockLength.note: Use as the provisional river-facing Rangmahal length; resolve conflict with the 125.4 m overall length by tracing the footprint and don't treat this as surveyed.

andarmahalBlockLength.source: 125.4 m overall extent minus the 55.8 m Rangmahal frontage working hypothesis
andarmahalBlockLength.note: Derived west/rear Andarmahal length for the provisional stepped plan. The actual historic footprint needs north-up trace/plan confirmation.

interiorGridEW.note: Recorded separately; not treated as exterior opening count.

interiorGridNS.note: Recorded separately; not treated as exterior opening count.

exteriorBayCount.source: One south-elevation reference photo; provisional symmetric composition 2 + 4 + 3 + 4 + 2
exteriorBayCount.note: This replaces the earlier uniform 24-bay assumption. Verify each bay from a straight-on elevation before treating the count as fixed.

averageBayPitch.source: 55.8 m Rangmahal river-front width / 15 estimated bays
averageBayPitch.note: Derived pitch for the provisional 2 + 4 + 3 + 4 + 2 facade rhythm; reconcile with the initial generic 4.5-5.5 m estimate using a straight-on elevation.

andarmahalDepth.source: Half of the 28.75 m overall depth, using the single-photo hypothesis that Andarmahal is set back to the north of the river-facing Rangmahal block
andarmahalDepth.note: This stepped/L-shaped plan is a provisional interpretation intended to reconcile the 56–62 m river-front Rangmahal width with the reported 125.4 m total extent. Verify from a north-up satellite trace or measured plan before survey-grade use.

andarmahalNorthOffset.source: Derived from the provisional 14.375 m Andarmahal depth and the 28.75 m overall depth
andarmahalNorthOffset.note: Centers the Andarmahal on the rear/north half of the total footprint so the public south-facing Rangmahal facade remains near 62.7 m wide. This is a modeling hypothesis, not a verified site measurement.

andarmahalBayCount.source: Procedural approximation for the older adjoining Andarmahal block
andarmahalBayCount.note: Keep separate from the 15-bay Rangmahal south-elevation composition; replace from a straight-on photo.

rooflineHeight.source: Calculated vertical stack including slabs and parapet

pilasterOrder.note: Fine capital and fluting geometry simplified.

coloredGlazing.value: dark rose/amber panels with simple mullions

porticoWidth.note: Working projection width for the central three-arch pavilion; recalibrate by counting its three arches from a straight-on photo.

porticoDepth.note: Projection depth of the central portico.

pedimentPeakHeightAboveGround.source: Approximate reference-photo proportion for the central pediment above the upper triple-arched loggia
pedimentPeakHeightAboveGround.note: Maintain the apex below the 27.13 m [V] dome peak; calibrate against a rectified front elevation.

doorBayInterval.source: Procedural modeling default until a rectified facade image is counted
doorBayInterval.note: Every fourth exterior bay is treated as a glazed door in LOD2/LOD3; actual count and placement require photo calibration.

stoneInlayBandWidth.source: Procedural placeholder for the stone inlay described in the heritage brief
stoneInlayBandWidth.note: Band width and exact stone pattern are unknown; replace after close-up door photographs.

doorGlazingPattern.value: simple multi-panel colored glazing with vertical center stile
doorGlazingPattern.source: Placeholder derived from documented colored-glass doors
doorGlazingPattern.note: Do not treat panel count/color pattern as verified.

balustradeHeight.source: Visible upper-veranda guardrail proportion in exterior photographs
balustradeHeight.note: Approximate top rail height above the veranda floor; not measured from a survey.

balusterSpacing.source: Procedural rendering parameter chosen to keep an even, readable upper-veranda balustrade
balusterSpacing.note: Approximate post interval; replace after elevation/photo calibration.

rooflinePinnacleHeight.source: Visible small roofline finials/pinnacles in exterior photographs
rooflinePinnacleHeight.note: Stylized height above the parapet; ornamental profile is illustrative and not a measured moulding.

riserHeight.note: 28 risers at 0.23 m give approximately 6.44 m rise to the upper portal.

treadDepth.note: Working tread depth chosen so the modeled treads fill the declared run.

stepCount.source: Single front reference photo estimate (25–30 steps)
stepCount.note: 28 steps; calibrate by counting steps in a straight-on image.

width.note: Approximate clear width at the garden-facing base of the stair.

runLength.note: Horizontal garden run from the upper portal toward the river; not site-surveyed.

topWidth.note: Approximate clear width at the upper portal; the stair tapers from 16.5 m at the base.

bodyHeight.source: Derived to meet 27.13 m peak with 13.6 m roofline and 2 m finial

profile.value: square base room → octagonal drum → lotus-bud dome → finial

drumOpeningCount.source: Reference-image interpretation of an open/fenestrated octagonal drum
drumOpeningCount.note: The procedural LOD2/LOD3 currently creates one open arched bay on each of the eight drum faces; verify from oblique and elevation photographs.

drumOpeningWidth.source: Reference-photo estimate for an open eight-sided colonnaded drum
drumOpeningWidth.note: Widened from narrow window slits to represent open arched colonnade bays; calibrate against an elevation photo.

drumOpeningCrownHeight.source: Reference-photo estimate for open arched drum bays
drumOpeningCrownHeight.note: Approximate crown height within the 5 m drum; final dimensions require rectified imagery.

profileRings.source: Procedural lotus-bud profile constrained to the 27.13 m peak
profileRings.note: Control points are illustrative; replace with samples from a rectified elevation photo.

facadePink.note: Warm salmon pink. Sample a colour-managed daylight photo for final calibrated RGB.

trimOffWhite.note: Trim stays in the same pink family as the body; the earlier off-white trim was incorrect.

roof.note: Muted rose roof/parapet proxy; calibrate from reference imagery.

stairStone.note: Dark grey-brown stone for the ceremonial exterior stair treads.

doorWood.note: Brown wood for the central glazed doors and timber shutter details.

covering.value: flat roof behind parapet; covering material unknown

lod1MaxDistance.unit: m from view centre to provisional anchor
lod1MaxDistance.note: Show only when the view centre is within 18 km and camera height is at most 20 km.

lod1MaxCameraHeight.note: Rendering threshold, not a building measurement.

lod2MaxDistance.unit: m from view centre to provisional anchor
lod2MaxDistance.note: Show when closer than this and camera height is at most 8 km unless LOD3 threshold is met.

lod2MaxCameraHeight.note: Rendering threshold, not a building measurement.

lod3MaxDistance.unit: m from view centre to provisional anchor
lod3MaxDistance.note: Show detail mesh when closer than this and camera height is at most 2.5 km.

lod3MaxCameraHeight.note: Rendering threshold, not a building measurement.

frontFocusOffsetEastMeters.source: Centre of the provisional 55.8 m Rangmahal frontage when the 125.4 m overall footprint extents are centred at the georeference origin: (125.4 - 55.8)/2 + 55.8/2 = 34.8 m
frontFocusOffsetEastMeters.note: Offsets the perspective camera target to the dome/main-entrance axis for frontal and orbit views; it does not move the model anchor.

frontCameraRangeMeters.source: Camera-framing estimate for the 62.7 m river-facing facade and 27.13 m dome peak
frontCameraRangeMeters.note: Designed to show the full facade and dome with a useful screen size; tune after a browser screenshot on the target display.

footprintCameraRangeMeters.source: Camera-framing estimate for the provisional 125.4 m overall footprint
footprintCameraRangeMeters.note: Used by the north-up Top view to fit the complete footprint with margins; tune after footprint trace.

orbitPitchDegrees.note: Low oblique angle for the front view and guided 360-degree orbit; not a building measurement.

orbitDegreesPerSecond.source: Usability choice for the guided 360-degree inspection camera
orbitDegreesPerSecond.note: One revolution is approximately 36 seconds; pause with Stop tour.

frontBoundingSphereRadiusMeters.source: Camera composition estimate for the offset front target and rear-set Andarmahal
frontBoundingSphereRadiusMeters.note: Camera framing radius large enough to keep the stepped west/rear Andarmahal, south-facing Rangmahal, and 27.13 m dome within the oblique inspection composition.

footprintBoundingSphereRadiusMeters.source: Bounding-sphere estimate for the 125.4 m overall footprint
footprintBoundingSphereRadiusMeters.note: Used by north-up Top view to fit the complete stepped footprint with margins.
